To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Ran/TC4 is required for the normal nuclear accumulation of an artificial karyophore in living cells and that Ran/TC 4 mediates an essential, nonimport function in mammalian cells.

Ran is required for the import of glucocorticoid receptors into the nucleus of living mammalian cells, but that the Ran mutant L43E inhibits this import and also causes a growth arrest, suggesting that Ran has at least one additional function in cells that is essential for cell survival.
the Ran/ TC4 GTPase, a nuclear transport factor, mediates an essential cellular function that is independent of its nuclear import function.
